description: OpenBrowser - local desktop fingerprint browser: isolated Chromium profiles, proxy/fingerprint/extension control, batch management, window sync, local RPA, Local API + MCP (127.0.0.1:50325).
notes: Local API/MCP on 127.0.0.1:50325. To use the C++ fingerprint kernel, set OpenBrowser's kernel path to <scoop dir>\fingerprint-chromium\current\chrome.exe. Bundled kernel (Wayfern) works out of the box.
